about.about: Akcent agency was founded in 2010 by a team of professionals with many years of experience in advertising. Our main activities are screen printing (direct printing on all kinds of textiles and promotional materials), vehicle branding and outdoor advertising. Our attention is entirely focused on the needs, ideas, wishes and vision of the client. Set out on the path to success with us now!
about.screenPrinting: Screen printing is a technology that allows direct printing on textiles (t-shirts, workwear, caps, bags, backpacks, etc.), lighters, pens, mugs, thermoses, calendars, business cards and ashtrays. Thanks to this we can print your ideas onto almost any surface, turning them into your advertising.
about.vehicleBranding: Advertising is a mirror of your business — and what could be better than advertising that works for you around the clock: on the way to work, on holiday or at a party. Show the world your ideas with the help of our experience.
about.outdoorAdvertising: This is the way to be noticed and stand out! Deliver your advertising message through attractive storefronts, illuminated signs, panels or billboards. Add colour to your business with creative outdoor advertising!
